episodeTitle.en: Driving alignment within teams, work-life balance, and the changing PM landscape | Nikita Miller
episodeTitle.zh: 推动团队内部协作、工作生活平衡及项目管理格局变革 | 尼基塔·米勒

guestBioOfficial.en: Nikita Miller is a product leader, angel investor, and advisor. She has built and led product teams at companies ranging from early-stage startups to multinationals, and she is currently SVP of Product Management at The Knot Worldwide. Nikita is passionate about scaling product teams to support high-growth businesses and was a product leader at Trello and Atlassian for five years. In today’s podcast, we cover: • Lessons from building and growing Trello
guestBioOfficial.zh: 尼基塔·米勒是一位产品领袖、天使投资人及顾问。她曾在从初创企业到跨国公司的多个产品团队中任职，目前担任The Knot Worldwide的产品管理高级副总裁。尼基塔热衷于通过扩展产品团队来支持高增长业务，并曾在Trello和Atlassian担任五年产品负责人。本期播客我们将涵盖：• 在Trello的建设与发展中汲取的经验教训

title.en: Driving alignment within teams, work-life balance, and the changing PM landscape | Nikita Miller
title.zh: 推动团队内部协作、工作生活平衡及项目管理格局变革 | 尼基塔·米勒

summary.en: Nikita discusses how to drive alignment and urgency within product teams, arguing against the myth of perfect work-life balance in favor of intentionally optimizing for what matters most at each stage. She covers the shifting structure of product teams - the rise of shared-accountability models like the Triad and the declining role of Scrum Masters - and why explicitly defining roles and responsibilities is a catalyst for velocity. The episode also explores empathy, distributed and remote teamwork, and building celebration into products.
summary.zh: Nikita 探讨了如何在产品团队内部推动对齐与紧迫感，主张放弃“完美工作生活平衡”的迷思，转而针对每个阶段最重要的事进行有意识的最优配置。她讲到了产品团队结构的演变——如“三人组（Triad）”式共同担责模式的兴起，以及 Scrum Master 角色的弱化——并解释了为什么明确定义角色与职责是提升团队速度的催化剂。本期还涉及同理心、分布式与远程协作，以及在产品中刻意营造“庆祝感”。
